weakness: Production secrets in a plaintext .env file on the laptop; long-lived CI token; old revoked token in public repository history
source: P07 assessment (IA-05(07)); P03 G-007; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Move local secrets into the password manager secrets feature and delete the .env file; rotate every secret; scoped deploy token rotated every 90 days; secret scanning with push protection on every repository; rewrite the demo repository history
milestones: 2026-10-15 secrets moved and rotated; 2026-10-31 scoped token and push protection on
resources_required: Owner time (1 day); password manager secrets feature about $60 a year

weakness: Domain registrar and product admin console sign in with a password only
remediation_plan: Registrar MFA and transfer lock now; authenticator MFA in the admin console for every administrator and support account; security keys for hosting, repository, email, and registrar
milestones: 2026-10-15 registrar MFA and lock on; 2026-11-30 admin console MFA live
resources_required: Owner time (2 days); two security keys about $110

weakness: Super-admin rights shared with the support contractor through the owner's login
source: P07 assessment (AC-06(05)); P03 G-005; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Change the super-admin password now; build a named support role that can view but not export; admin action log; security terms in the contractor agreement
milestones: 2026-10-15 password changed and contractor agreement updated; 2026-11-30 support role and action log live

weakness: Backups only inside the production account; photo uploads not backed up
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09d.[03]); P01 R-007; P03 G-033
remediation_plan: Nightly encrypted database export to a separate storage account the CI token cannot reach; versioning and a nightly copy for photo storage
milestones: 2026-11-30 photo versioning on; 2026-12-31 outside copies running and checked

weakness: No test frequency and no written restore steps; photo restore untested
remediation_plan: Write restore steps from the 2026-08-27 test; test photo restore with POAM-004; yearly test each August (POL-01 11.3)
milestones: 2026-10-31 restore steps written; 2026-12-31 photo restore tested

weakness: AI model provider used with no DPA and not on the sub-processor list; no provider oversight; contractor agreement without security terms
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-021, G-022, G-037; P01 R-009
remediation_plan: Sign the model provider DPA with no-training and retention terms; add it to the list with 14 days' notice; yearly review of each sub-processor (P09); contractor security terms (POAM-003)
milestones: 2026-10-31 DPA signed and subscribers notified; 2026-12-31 all sub-processor reviews done

weakness: Logs never reviewed; admin console actions not logged; hosting log kept only 30 days
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 G-014; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day with a checklist; sign-in and new-token alerts; monthly export of the hosting log to keep 12 months; weekly review for 3 months after any incident
milestones: 2026-10-01 first review; 2026-11-30 alerts and admin action log live

weakness: No incident reporting duty for the contractor and no notification contact list
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-031, G-039; P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and matrix; contractor reports suspected incidents within 1 hour; subscriber security contact list with the two 48-hour customers flagged; identify breach counsel; walkthrough with the consultant
milestones: 2026-10-15 contact list built and counsel identified; 2026-10-31 walkthrough done
resources_required: Owner time; consultant half day about $400

weakness: Dependency alerts untriaged (2 high severity); running application never scanned
source: P07 assessment (RA-05 objectives); P03 G-020, G-023; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: Fix the 2 high-severity alerts; monthly triage with fix times (high 14 days, others 30 days); quarterly web application scan with a free scanner
milestones: 2026-10-31 high alerts fixed and first triage done; 2026-12-31 first application scan
